Results.ReviewText: I hope you sell a lot of these.  I don't  want to be the only fool. I consider myself a better than average cook. Your unit is  15 degrees off the thermostat. I see your pretty pictures and there's no way you get that searing. I have several cookers (griddles stoves pits fryers etc.) This by far the worst.

Results.ReviewText: The grill works very well but is a bit temperamental.  I have cooked 4 briskets and they came out delicious.  My wife particularly likes pizza cook on the grill.  The grill grates are very easy to clean.  The steel construction is great heavy duty and the grill is easy to use (per say).  However I thoroughly believe the grills are too expensive.  The downside is that the 2 grill pans (flame guard and drip pan) rust really bad and fast.  The other draw back are the pellets: They must be stored inside the home where the air is condition.  The wood pellets draw moisture from the air which makes them burn less hot which interferes with heat temperatures.  Lastly it takes a long time to reach higher temperatures especially during the winter time; a blanket Overall I gave it a 4 because I can fill the hopper and cook for 5  hours without refueling.  Once it's fired-up it cooks really good.  I would give it a 5 but it is too temperamental.  It's difficult to reach higher temperatures which throws my timing off and at times when I least expect to malfunction.  When it does malfunction I forced to restart the grill.

Results.ReviewText: My Traeger Pro Series 22 has really exceeded my expectations.  I did read from other users that it is a great smoker but not a good grill.  I think it works great as a grill.  After grilling chicken pieces I baked a pan of brownies and they were as good as if they were done in the oven.  Traeger advertises that but frankly I didn't believe it would work that well.    My problem is with the temp probes.  The first time I used the unit they worked fine.  After that they haven't worked at all.  I needed to go out and by a separate digital meat temp probe which works perfectly except for having to open the grill to check the meat.    I also noticed a temperature swing of at least 25 degrees during my last cook.  I was smoking three racks of ribs at 225 deg.    We will see if that continues next time.    For the most part I would have to say I love it and would do it again.  It is a perfect size for me and I have already appreciated being able to empty the hopper

Results.ReviewText: I have had my Traeger for little over a month now. I have grilled steaks burgers pork bellies pizza and chicken breasts on this thing. They turned out pretty good except it wasn't set it and forget it. I had to check the food regularly to ensure I didn't over cook it because like 1 other review my temperature just wouldn't get to the proper temp but it was definitely getting hot. In an attempt to diagnose why I was having this issue when only 1 other person has had this issue I noticed my internal probe was touching the side of the grill. I bent it slightly inward so it was no longer touching the side. I now get to temperature within the 15 minutes and the last chicken breast came out perfect. I strongly recommend this grill for anyone who not only loves to grill but even just enjoys good food.

Results.ReviewText: After waffling for about 3 years we finally took the plunge and ordered up a Traeger. Of course it was in transit on #traegerday so all I could post was an empty spot on our deck. Anyhow it came in and rather than wait the extra 6 hours for FedEx to bring it around I took a drive to their depot and picked it up. Just as impatient at 53 as I was at 15. Got it home opened up the box and everything was right where it was supposed to be. If comes with all the hardware (plus spare nuts/bolts/washers) and every tool needed except a bottle opener. Assembly was flawless and it was very nice to have the extra parts even though I didn't need them. Trust me though if there weren't extras I would have lost something.   So anyhow after it was assembled I had the honor of looking at it for a day and a half since the pellets were still in transit. Impatience part 2: trip to the hardware store for a bag of Hickory since UPS was taking their sweet time shuffling out here. Fired it up per instructions everything worked like a champ. I've been cranking out all kinds of chicken salmon veggies 'taters and as I write this there's a brisket in there getting the spa treatment.  It has more than enough room for plenty of food. The included cookbook is aces and there is no shortage of online hints tips and concoctions to make every meal something new. This grill is truly magic I think if I accidentally threw one of my shoes in there it would come out like a mouth watering treat from heaven.  Traeger thanks for being you!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Pro 34 almost a year ago.  Have had great success with all meats I have  smoked or grilled.  I have a cheap Brinkman electric smoker that was my intro into the smoking world about ten years ago.   The Traeger is so simple.  Set the temp you need and in ten to fifteen minutes you are ready to smoke or grill.  With the temp probes you can check meat temp as your cooking progresses.  I have used both probes multiple times. On Mother's Day weekend I was asked to smoke many different meats.  I accepted the challenge and simultaneously smoked baby backs pork shoulder and tri-tip roast. Tri-tip was done first in two and half hours to a beautiful 130 degrees F.  The ribs were smoked using the 1-2-3 method and were excellent  The shoulder took almost 16 hours to reach my desired temp of 204-205 F.  All smoking was set at 225 F.  I pushed it to 250 F to finish pork shoulder.  All this was for two meals and many food saver bags going home with my kids and other family. My Traeger Pro 34 has performed excellently! Also if you smoke or grill a lot check under grease drain pan and heat baffle.  If there is a buildup of wood dust ash and a little grease I use a shop vac to clean out dust and ash. Wipe up grease with paper towel. Also clean out firepot as recommended.
Results.Title: Excellent Smoking and Grilling

Results.ReviewText: I've been smoking for many years from the manual add-wood-and-charcoal-all-day-long to electric. I finally decided to take the plunge and ordered a Traeger after  years of hearing how good they were from multiple people. Assembly: It took about an hour to put together requiring only a screwdriver and wrench (which were both included). The smoker is solid. I can see this thing lasting for a long time. All of the parts looked immaculate - no scratches dings burrs bad cuts etc. Traeger really did a good job on the QA for this one. On the initial burn in the smoker got to about 450 degrees and then backed down to around 435-440. Cooking: First cook was 4 racks of spare ribs (with tips) that fit with ease. Best rack of ribs I have ever smoked and the easiest as well no more babysitting the food or smoker. The only downside to the pellet smoker is the extra cost to cook as pellets are not cheap but the taste in the food is definitely superior to electric w/wood chips which makes it worth it to me. My electric smoker is going into storage. Easily 5 star rating.

Results.ReviewText: I received this for Christmas this year (2017).  I actually bought it for myself and the wife wrapped it.  The grill was easy to assemble and like others have said shipped fast.  I can't believe how well they package the grill and its components to be safe during shipping.  It took me longer to unbox unwrap and unbag the grill and components than it did to assemble it.  I was so excited.  I followed the instructions did my first 'burn' of the grill and couldn't wait to actually cook on it.  Having switched from my gas Weber I didn't really know what to expect.  While cooking my first couple of cheap steaks I was ready to throw the Traeger off the deck and I was yelling to my wife that I wasted a lot of money.  Then when the steaks were finally done I couldn't believe how well they tasted.  I cooked on my Traeger for 6 nights in a row after the first cook and I can honestly tell you its easy produces the most amazing food and I now LOVE my Traeger.  Please understand this.  This is not a gas grill.  It takes about 20-30 minutes to come to heat before cooking.  Once you allow it to come to temp the cooking time is no different than a charcoal or gas grill.    Buy one today!  You will not regret it!  I love my Traeger so much I am considering selling a very expensive electric smoker my gas Weber Genesis and my charcoal Weber.

It doesn't matter what the weather is it will hold at what ever temperature you set it at. It is not only for ribs and brisket.  I've cooked about every thing you can think of.  Bacon chicken turkey stuffed pork chops smoked my own bacon etc.  Crank the heat up and throw a frozen pizza on for 10 minutes it's great.  Never have I had a grill of any sort that will last as long or  be as versatile as this grill/smoker is. I live in a small town and 6 of my neighbors now own a traeger.  All had to check it out after smelling that mouth-watering aroma of the smoke coming from my yard.  One look at what it can do and they were hooked.
Results.Title: GREATEST THING SINCE SLICED BREAD

Results.ReviewText: Got this as our Christmas present this year...have used it twice so far and have had two perfect meals! Smoked a turkey in the beginning of the month and today smoked the.most.awesome.prime rib roast!  My husband loves it and is making his smoking to-do list!
Results.Title: So easy!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Traeger.  My first one was a Pro22 and loved it so much that I gave it to my kids so they could enjoy the greatness of a Traeger and bought me the Pro34.  It is amazing.  Briskets pork tenderloin you name it it all turns out great!!  I have also just purchased the Tailgater to take camping and I can't wait to use it.  Thank you Traeger for a fantastic grill!!.  Brendon
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to Assemble.  It shipped really quickly and I was surprised how quickly I put it together.   Cooked Wings first and I should have dried the wings out more.  I was a little impatient to get something going.  Coming from my homemade UDS this was a premium upgrade from what I was used to doing to smoke.  I will be smoking fresh salmon I caught in Alaska this summer.  Can't wait.    Don't wait for the right time get off the fence and order one of these things.
Results.Title: Happy So Far

Results.ReviewText: i was on the fence for about a year. I finally bought one!  I could not be happier. My only regret is I did not do it sooner. My wife doesn't like smoked meat but has asked me to repeat a smoked chicken. Both my kids love the process and are actively involved.   The recipes and instructions are easy.  Putting the grill together was very easy.    Seriously great product.  Wish I had bought one years back.  No I am not getting paid or did I get a free grill.
Results.Title: Great!!

Results.ReviewText: I was very excited when it arrived. The smoker was very easy to put together and the instructions were easy to read and understand. I have cooked on my smoker just about every day since I've gotten it and I have not had a bad meal yet. So easy to use and good is amazing
Results.Title: I love my Treager

Results.ReviewText: Works great. My only complaint is the entire grill gets extremely hot and handles lossen easily so I'm continually having to tighten the handles.
Results.Title: 22 pro series

Results.ReviewText: this is my second Traeger. My first one is the Tailgater  which  is the perfect size for the weekend smoker. I bought the pro series 34 for my nonprofit company to use during cookouts and fundraising events. This grill is truly set and forget not to mention being solidly built with a ton of grill space.  Don't hesitate just buy it!!!
Results.Title: Sweet Mother Of God

Results.ReviewText: I've been a happy owner of a Traeger grill for over 4 years now.  I love to grill but now everyone asks for me to grill.  Try one and you will never go back. TRAEGER  = BOSS. I have the older model the new ones are even better.
Results.Title: Best there is.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has gotten me in TROUBLE. Started cooking on it. Invited some [Friends] over.  now my kids and Grandchildern cook on it so much.  I had to get a second one for me. My friends bring food and pellets over for me to cook.  At least I get to eat. LOVE my grills. Tried the Turkey blend and Brine mix. we wont be deep frying any more.
Results.Title: OOPs  got my second grill

Results.ReviewText: I agree with Lee (except for last statement). DO buy the cover if you are going to store outside on the deck as I do. The cover is super heavy duty impervious to elements and strong winds won't even budge it.
Results.Title: Very Best

Results.ReviewText: Love my 22.  This is one of the greatest grills - smokers I've owned.  From rods to jerky it the best.
Results.Title: Pro 22 Awesome

Results.ReviewText: Love it should have bought sooner don't wait buy it today!
Results.Title: Should have bought sooner

Results.ReviewText: Love my Traeger grill!! Best grill and smoker I ever owned
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Saw the infomercial on tv  and kicked around purchasing the Traegar. After careful consideration I bit the bullet and did. Once you get the hang of it it is easier and faster than a charcoal and gas grill plus you get the great flavor of what ever type of wood flavor you want. I was scared to attempt to cook brisket on the other grills but with the Traegar it is very easy and great flavor. A bag of pellets last as long or longer than a 20 # bottle of propane. Storage of the pellets is easy just go to your hardware store and buy a % gallon bucket with lid and keep it sealed until use. I have had my Traegar for about a year and a half the charcoal and gas grills hardly ever get used any more. If you want real smoked flavor and convenience this grill should be highly considered. (Don't buy the cover you will never use it.)
Results.Title: better than charcoal

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It took a little bit of practice to figure it out but it has been reliable excellent for larger cuts of meat ribs roasts etc. Burgers are just ok however as it bakes the patties more than searing them but it's probably just me.  It does go through the pellets fairly quickly but the taste is worth it. The only issue I had was the grease pan rusted but it was replaced under warranty.  The warranty runs three years. I do use a grill cover and which I highly recommend.
Results.Title: Traeger 34

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill I have cooked ribs steaks hamburgers fish brisket (just set it and forget it over night)-chicken and one of my favorite things....PIZZA ! I also tried smoked potato salad EVERYTHING I cook on this grill is awesome. I cant wait to try even more recipes. I hardly ever cook on my stove or my old gas grill anymore there is no need when I have this that will do it all.
Results.Title: In Love

Results.ReviewText: We purchased a Traeger PTG a year ago for our RV and have never been disappointed but we wanted something a bit larger for home. My wife surprised me with the Pro Series 22 for my birthday and we are enjoying delicious meals every time. It's the perfect size for two people like ourselves that occasionally entertain another couple or two. We like to try new and different recipes and it's great to know our Traeger can be relied on to perform perfectly every time.
Results.Title: Never a Bad Meal

Results.ReviewText: I have been a wood smoker (not gas or electric) for 20  years and got tired one day of the production involved in smoking.  I couldn't just smoke something for myself without hours of work.  I have several friends with gas smokers and I didn't feel the taste was anywhere close to real wood.  Then I saw my Brother's Traeger and ate some awesome baby back ribs at his house.  Soon I bought my own Traeger and have given my wood smoker to a friend.  I am awe struck as to the ease and flavor of the Traeger grill.  You have a customer for life!!
Results.Title: I can't believe it but I love it!!

Results.ReviewText: I had my Pro Series 22 for less than a week and I attempted to smoke a 10lb brisket for the first time for a family even though folks (including my wife) said brisket was tough to cook.   I used the Chef's Brisket recipe on the Traeger app and it turned out amazing.  Although I had some concern once the internal temp got to 160 a friend told me about 'the stall'.  Once I just trusted the recipe it turned out great!  Party turned out great and everyone was impressed.
Results.Title: Amazing Brisket

Results.ReviewText: Best investment for a grill I've made it years. Even though I've only been a Traeger Grill owner for a few short months I've cooked everything from hot Dogs to steak to ribs and roast my next adventure may be a turkey!
Results.Title: Mr

Results.ReviewText: My deck was getting to crowded.  I do a lot of cooking and had a gas and charcoal  grill plus a charcoal smoker.  Always a lot of work maintaining the three (clean-up keeping up the fuel  maintaining temp etc.)  Love the ease of use.  I was always guilty of over-smoking my meats not a problem anymore.  I learned how to reverse sear and cook without it heat shield if necessary.  Love the grill.  Just a Hint you spent the money take the time to learn the proper care and usage.  I bought mine at a local shop and the rep walked me through everything.
Results.Title: Beyond Everything  I Expected.

Results.ReviewText: I was sceptical at first. I bought the grill mainly for a smoker. My local sales rep said I would never use my gas grill again. He was right! I haven't used anything but the Traeger. I always get rave reviews on my grilling skills but this machine is the best. I can't believe how much better my food taste now.
Results.Title: Well worth the money

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I have ever owned. It is the easiest grill to operate. The food turns out great everytime. I wouldn't own anything but a Traeger!!
Results.Title: The Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: The guy at Costco saw me coming a mile away!  I had been looking at smokers for the better part of a year or more so I kind of knew what I wanted.  I was looking at Green Mountain and Traeger Grills.    So I am not calling this an impulse purchase when I heard about all the cool things it could do non 'beef' related I was sold.  We have had it for just over a week now and have gone through a 33lb bag of pellets I picked up 2 more bags last night and love the food that comes off this Grill it is amazing even a baked potato tastes so much better in the Traeger we had salmon the other night best salmon I have ever had!
Results.Title: We went to Costco for Dog food! Came home with a Traeger!

Results.ReviewText: I have had my grill for 6  years and have never stored or covered it(winter or summer). I grill on it 7-10 times per month and have never had to do anything besides clean it once in awhile. I would never buy anything but a Traeger ... hands down the best grill you can buy.
Results.Title: Best Grill Hands Down

Results.ReviewText: Coming from a natural gas grill and the simplicity of turning it on and grilling away I was skeptical as to how simple the traeger experience would be...it has far surpassed my expectations.  Especially because it makes managing the grilling process easier.  I don't really have to manage the meat as much during the cooking process.  I don't have flare ups to worry about and I'm much less likely to burn the meat on the traeger.  Plus everything has been juicy and flavorful.  I'm converted!
Results.Title: Great experience

Results.ReviewText: These smokers are money! Cooked a few items while learning and have yet to produce anything less than great.  Everyone asks about it love the ease and variety of foods that can cook.  Still waiting on a portion of my order but worth the wait - I love my Weber but it has yet to turn on for the past month because of my Traeger.
Results.Title: Money!

Results.ReviewText: Man this sucker is biiiiiiig.   You can do 2 full turkeys inside this thing no problem.   The first day I got it I made the easy ribs recipie.   Turned out perfect!   Next day did a turkey.    Mega jucy but a little light on the smokey flavor.  I definetly need to figure out how to get a bit more smoke flavor into my birds.   But still a five star overall.   It is a bit pricey but to me it's worth the almost zero effort cooking that it offers you.
Results.Title: Totally amazingly delicious

Results.ReviewText: I was shocked and thrilled to get this fine quality machine from my son on Father's Day!  I'm impressed with the heavy duty construction and ease of use.  No more charcoal fires or guesswork about the amount of coals to use cooking temp or meat temp.  Just turn the switch on let it start smoking have a beer put the steaks on have a beer and  get ready to eat the most flavorful steaks I've ever had.  We've been using it every weekend and I'm no cook but I can now create some dazzling meals.  Are working through the recipe book and looking forward to many great meals.  Thank You Son and Thank You Traeger!
Results.Title: THE Best Smoker and Griller

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Pro Series 34 for my husband for his combo Father's Day Birthday and Anniversary gift this year. We entertain quite a bit and this is his first pellet product. He did give me a hint that this would be a gift he would like so I bought everything I thought he would need to get started. We have had fish steaks ribs brisket pork butt corn on the cob asparagus peaches and pineapple so far. We have only cooked on it one weekend for a crowd but plan more BBQ's real soon. We have been very happy with the results. He is looking forward to 'learning' how to use his new Pro 34 Traeger!!
Results.Title: Pro Series 34

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a Pro 34 from a local BBQ supply shop. I had been looking for some time. They carry many brands and models and this is what they recommended. I am very glad I took their advice. It is super easy to use. The quality appears top notch and so far it works like a charm. The controls and process are easy and intuitive. Even a basic hot dog tastes completely different. It makes smoking and grilling very simple but also doesn't limit an experienced grill master. My only regret is that I didn't purchase this years ago. Thanks for a great product.
Results.Title: Game Changer

Results.ReviewText: Received My Traeger on June 5th 2017 Set up was smooth. Looked thru the recipe book provided and decided on the 123 Ribs. My first attempt at smoking/grilling. Let me tell you those were the best ribs my wife and i had ever eaten. And i have made those ribs once a week since then. I have cooked on my Traeger almost every night since then too. I  love my Traeger Pro series 22. The word is to clean every other cooking yet i enjoy it so much i do it every time its used.  Plenty of cook space. and love the sauces by Traeger. We have our eye on the Timberline series.
Results.Title: Bronze Pro 22 Best Smoker/ Grill Ever Made

Results.ReviewText: I'm always too nervous to try to grill anything. I just know that I'm going to over cook or under cook the meat. I just stay in the kitchen. Not anymore! With the Traeger it is so easy to make delicious food with confidence and not need the help of my boyfriend to do it! I'm now obsessed with looking at recipes and trying new things! Assembly was easy and it's so funny that they tell you where you should be in a six pack on each step. The only thing it was missing was a spot that says 'If you bought the bottom shelf now would be the time to install it'. I'm not sure why the front folding shelf doesn't come with it because it is an absolute necessity. It's super easy to move around. We're going to have so many backyard BBQ's! Happy grilling and smoking!!!
Results.Title: I love this smoker!!!

Results.ReviewText: Cooked my first meal on my Pro 22 (pork loin) and my wife said we are selling our other BBQ.
Results.Title: Fabulous

Results.ReviewText: I love good BBQ but I often don't have enough time to babysit a piece of meat all the while trying to regulate a charcoal smoker and electric smokers just don't give it enough flavor. I like things simple. My gas smoker burns through chips like its going out of style or the flame gets blown out by wind. This grill is perfect solution for me. You get the most simplistic method of smoking but you also get top notch flavor. A lot of stuff you can just set it and walk away. Not only that but it is so versatile you can nearly cook anything on it. I'm in love with my Pro 34. Everything that's come off of this grill has been better than anything I've e attempted before. I'm pretty sure it has mystical powers.
Results.Title: Best thing that's ever happened to my BBQ quest

Results.ReviewText: Sold my 5 burner propane grill that fed friends and family for years so we could get the Pro 22. What a great decision! everything that we have cooked on the Traeger has came out phenomenal and I mean everything. My only regret is that I didn't spend the extra money to get the Pro 34. Maybe that was just fate telling me to hold off until next year to get the Timberline.
Results.Title: Best way to cook...hands down.

Results.ReviewText: Very pleased with shipping packaging assembly and performance. I am very pleased with the purchase worth the money if you grill smoke or bbq alot.
Results.Title: Best grill I have owned to date!!

Results.ReviewText: It does everything that is advertised the only thing that isn't correct is the commercial I saw on TV said that the wood pellets last almost as long as an LP gas cylinder  ot even close' you guys need to change that message because you really do have a great product.
Results.Title: Works Good. very pleased

Results.ReviewText: I did a lot of searching before I came to the conclusion of buying a traeger. Yes I looked at the all but everything brought me back to them I have since my purchase sold my old bbq and have not even turned my oven on best food I have ever  cooked has come off this sexy thing!
Results.Title: Best investment
